plan.title: Reject duplicate Price column in Single Stage RFQ

steps.note: Open the Single Stage event creation screen.
Set the event type to RFQ as required by the case.
Provide the mandatory event title so the create screen is valid.
Apply the first available RFQ template so the pricing sheet is rendered.

args.goal: On the RFQ product sheet, add the product CYLINDER and choose CYLINDER WITH KEY & KNOB so Product Variant becomes Default Variant; set Quantity Requested to 10; set Delivery location to Plant Name (LOC-0001); open Add Columns, attempt to add a column named Price, and stop when the screen shows the refusal message "Column already exists".

steps.note: Perform and verify the sheet-specific interactions and the duplicate-column refusal.
